verdict.rationale: Porkbun supports event-driven automation via signed webhooks (registrations, renewals, transfers, DNS changes) instead of polling, and offers some built-in auto-actions like auto-renewal and dynamic-DNS IP detection, letting external systems react to events. However, there is no native rule-engine or conditional 'if event X then action Y' builder inside Porkbun itself — automation logic must be implemented externally by the consumer of the webhook. Missing for 10: a first-party rules/automation engine, conditional trigger-action pairing beyond auto-renew, and any UI/API for defining custom event-triggered workflows.
